changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
📺 TextureView Rendering Engine: Completely eliminates hardware overlay plane punch-through failures and Z-ordering bugs on older Smart TV chipsets (Panasonic, Toshiba, Fire TV OS 5/6/7).
✨ Clean Theme Transparency: Removed global background overrides in styles.xml that were painting solid black over video planes.
🛡️ Unconditional Hardware ExoPlayer: Bypasses WebView player completely on all TV models regardless of manufacturer or Android OS version.
⚡ Permissive SSL & Manifest Engine: Allows mid-GOP TS segments, tokenized playlists, and legacy root CA validation.
🔙 Deterministic Back Button: Returns cleanly from PlayerActivity with focus restored to the active card.
